# Trancz Fashion

> Trancz Fashion (TRANC'Z) is a GST-registered private label / white-label garment manufacturer in Dombivli East, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It manufactures apparel for streetwear brands, fast-fashion and lifestyle labels, startup clothing lines and corporate clients, with sampling, pattern making, fabric sourcing, printing and embroidery under one roof. Founder: Rohit Jain.

## Key facts
- Business type: Private label / white-label garment manufacturer (B2B)
- Location: Dombivli East, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; ships pan-India
- Products: hoodies, sweatshirts, T-shirts, polo shirts, shirts, jackets, track pants, pants
- Clients: streetwear brands, fast-fashion labels, lifestyle brands, startup clothing brands, corporates (branded apparel & gifting)
- Sampling time: typically 7–14 business days
- Bulk lead time: minimum about one month after designs, samples and approvals are final
- Payment terms: 50% advance, 50% on delivery; no credit facilities
- GST invoices provided
- Contact: rohit@trancz.com · WhatsApp/phone +91 80972 83931 · Instagram @tranczfashion

## Services
- Private label manufacturing: design, sourcing, production, custom tags, labels and branding
- Sampling & prototype development
- Pattern making from tech packs, sketches or reference garments (tech pack not required)
- Fabric sourcing and custom knit/woven fabric development (cotton, polyester, fleece, performance, blends)
- Printing: HD print, puff print, DTF, foil print, spray print, screen print, digital print
- Embroidery
- Corporate gifting: custom-branded hoodies, track pants, T-shirts and polo shirts for companies, teams and events
